meta.description: Al-Murshid design tokens: color, sky, type, space and motion.

title: Quiet Light
intro: Light itself is the language: the sky is the only strong color, surfaces float like paper and glass, and one warm lantern marks what matters.

sections.colorHint: Every pair here passes WCAG AA, by day and by night.
sections.skyHint: The anchor stops. The living sky moves between them with the sun.
sections.typeHint: Readex Pro for the interface, Amiri for transmitted texts. Arabic runs larger and looser.
sections.spaceHint: A 4-point grid, and touch targets of at least {size, number} points everywhere.
sections.motionHint: Press and hold. Every pressable settles back on a gentle spring.

specimen.headline: The five moments of your day
specimen.body: A calm companion that shows up at each prayer moment, then gets out of the way.
specimen.caption: Built for every age, Arabic first.
specimen.sacredSample: خطّ النسخ الكلاسيكي، مخصّصٌ للنصوص المأثورة
